questionText: A projectile is launched from horizontal ground with an initial velocity v₀ at an angle of 60° above the horizontal. If air resistance is negligible, at what other launch angle will the projectile achieve the exact same horizontal range?
explanation: Complimentary angles (θ and 90° - θ) yield identical horizontal ranges in projectile motion when initial velocity is held constant.

questionText: A small object slides down from the top of a smooth, frictionless hemispherical dome of radius R fixed on a horizontal floor. If it starts moving from rest at the absolute apex, at what vertical height h from the ground will the object lose physical contact with the surface of the dome?
explanation: By conserving mechanical energy and finding the point where the normal force shrinks to exactly zero (N = 0), we find the object detaches at h = 2R/3.
